founder.name: Abdullah
founder.bio: Started Close Crew as a hands-on performance marketing team, and built it into a network by doing the unglamorous work first: vetting publishers, tightening call quality, and getting compliance right before scaling volume.

ceo.name: Syed Wahaj
ceo.message: We built Close Crew because both sides of this market deserved better. Advertisers were tired of paying for recycled data, and publishers were tired of opaque payouts and slow payments. Our answer is simple: vet every publisher before they route a single call, show advertisers exactly what they're paying for, and pay partners on the terms we publish. We would rather grow slower with sources we trust than scale fast on volume we can't stand behind.

testimonials.name: Marcus Chen
testimonials.quote: The call quality held up as we scaled, which is not what we'd seen elsewhere. When a source started slipping, their team flagged it before we did.

testimonials.name: Priya Raman
testimonials.quote: Payouts land on the schedule they publish, and the portal shows why every call qualified or didn't. That transparency is the reason we kept scaling with them.

testimonials.name: David Okafor
testimonials.quote: Their AEP capacity planning was the difference for us. We agreed pacing in August instead of scrambling in October, and our agents stayed busy without drowning.

testimonials.name: Sarah Whitfield
testimonials.quote: Consent records and call recordings were produced the same day we asked. For a lead source, that alone puts them ahead of most vendors we review.

testimonials.name: Tomás Herrera
testimonials.quote: Straight answers on what traffic they accept and what they don't. We knew where we stood before we sent a single click.

testimonials.name: Alicia Brooks
testimonials.quote: Persistency improved once we switched to their consented inbound calls. Fewer leads, better conversations, better book.
